name: Ole Mink Farm Recreation Resort
skip_reason: Seasonal-only, stated by the operator. oleminkfarm.com says overnight RV camping is NOT available: the RV product is 'Exclusive Seasonal Campsites' where you park once and leave the rig for the year, winter storage on site included. Everything else it sells is lodging - one-, two- and three-to-four-bedroom luxury log cabins and pet-friendly log cabinettes - which is why VisitMaryland files it under cabins and lodges. A real and thriving business, excluded as seasonal-plus-cabins rather than for any doubt about it. RV Life's avg_rate of 0 is consistent with there being no nightly RV rate to average.

name: Camp Ramblewood
skip_reason: Group-only retreat and event centre, not a public campground. Ramblewood operates exclusively for organized gatherings rather than individual bookings - a 200-acre property with dining hall, amphitheatre, dance pavilion, Olympic pool and on-site chefs, taking RVs only as part of a booked group event. Group-only is an explicit inclusion exclusion. Separately worth noting the aggregator trail: one of the listings for it is on pinecliffresort.net, the known campground content farm.
